remarks: Renovated Corner Unit in a Prime SoNo Location! This stylish & modern 'Cool Crash Pad' is being completely refreshed with modern upgrades. The kitchen will feature all NEW wood cabinetry, NEW stainless steel appliances, sleek granite countertops & backsplash, & NEW flooring. Enjoy smart features: NEST WiFi thermostat & enhanced LED lighting w smart dimmer & remote control. The open living space is highlighted by a new electric LED fireplace. Additional updates include fresh paint, newly installed electrical outlets, switches, & plates, plus motorized blinds with remote control (light-filtering shades in the living room & blackout shades in BR). The modernized bathroom adds to the unit's stylish appeal, while a ceiling fan in the BR enhances comfort. +Gated, motorized garage w remote. Located in the heart of vibrant, historic SoNo, offering easy access to Washington St international restaurants, art galleries, Maritime Aquarium, boutique shopping, plus the upscale SoNo Collection Mall. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the proximity to Oyster Shell Park, Calf Pasture Beach, and scenic walking, biking, & jogging trails. With 10' ceilings and oversized windows, this bright, airy, corner unit is one of a kind. Building amenities feature a fully-equipped gym, storage locker & bike room. Pet-friendly! +Short walk to MetroNorth Train. "Turn-Key Ready" in desirable "SoNo Hot Spot"!
